 versus  THE STATE GNCT OF DELHI ..... Res  Through: Mr. Sunil Kumar Gautam, APP   State & SI Pankaj, PS Ambedk  Nagar  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 22.05.2023 1.

This appeal has been filed assailing the impugned judgment of conviction dated 15th February,
2023 and order on sentence dated 28th April, 2023 passed by Ld. Principal and District Judge,
(South District), Saket Courts in Sessions Case No.591/2017, arising out of FIR No.334/2017 at PS Ambedkar Nagar under sections 498A/304B IPC.
2. Admit.
3. List in due course in the category of 'Regular Matters' as per its own turn.
4. TCR be also requisitioned and digital copy of the same be supplied to the learned counsels for the parties, as and when so requested. CRL.M.(BAIL) 722/2023 1.
This application has been filed seeking regular suspension of sentence pending adjudication of appeal by this Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 21:47:26 2.
Issue notice.
Ld. APP for the State accepts notice.
3. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that as regards appellants Nos.2 and 3, parents-in-law of deceased, are aged 58 and 55 years respectively and are suffering from various ailments.
Appellant No.2 has undergone by-pass surgery.

sentences.text: 1 sentenced appellant Nos. 2 and 3 for imprisonment for 3 years for offences punishable under sections 306/34 IPC.
Further, they have been out on bail throughout the period of trial.
4. Further, appellants Nos.4 and 5, sisters-in-law of deceased, are both married and living in their respective matrimonial homes.
Appellant no.4 has a child who is hearing impaired and appellant no.5 has a 2 years old child.
Considering these facts, the Ld. Trial Court has sentenced them for 2 years for offences punishable under sections 306/34 IPC.
Further, they have been out on bail throughout the period of trial.

5. In view of these circumstances, learned counsel for the appellants pleads that the sentence of appellants nos. 2 to 5 be suspended pending disposal of the appeal by this Court, which shall take some time.
It is also informed that appellant no.1, husband of deceased is in custody.

6. In view of the facts and circumstances as noted above by the Ld. Trial Court, the sentence of appellants nos. 2 to 5 shall remain suspended on their furnishing a personal bond in the sum of 25,000/- each with one surety bond each of the like amount, subject to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/ CMM/ Duty Magistrate, further subject to the following conditions:
i. Appellant Nos. 2 to 5 will not leave the country without prior permission of the Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 21:47:26 ii.
Appellant Nos. 2 to 5 shall provide permanent address to the Ld. Trial Court.
The appellants shall intimate the Court by way of an affidavit and to the IO regarding any change in residential address.

iii. Appellant Nos.
2 to 5 shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.

iv. Appellant Nos. 2 to 5 shall provide all mobile numbers to the IO concerned which shall be kept in working condition at all times and shall not switch off or change the mobile number without prior intimation to the IO concerned.
The mobile location be kept on at all times.

v. Appellant Nos. 2 to 5 shall not indulge in any criminal activity and shall not communicate with or come in contact with the complainant/victim or any member of the complainant/victim's family or tamper with the evidence of the case.

7. Needless to state, but any observation touching the merits of the case is purely for the purposes of deciding the question of suspension of sentence and shall not be construed as an expression on merits of the matter.
8.
Copy of the order be sent to the Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
